functions.residue: RESIDUE UNDERGEN 88 0x554 vs slot 0x5ac (default flags); with WGATE_FLAGS="-opt speed": RESIDUE UNDERGEN 16 0x59c vs slot 0x5ac
functions.notes: Full structure written (typed Loader/Header/Pool/Entry/Reader structs, all control flow and offsets). Target inlines a full 'add sp; moveq r0,#0; popeq' epilogue at every one of ~20 failure exits and does not save sl; default -O2 tail-merges them into one shared epilogue (22 instructions shorter). Only -opt speed moves the size toward the slot (0x59c vs 0x5ac). Looks like speed-built (,p) middleware (MODSN stream/decoder library), so stopped early per instructions. About 9 gate runs used.
